facts.text: Interlaken lies between Lakes Thun and Brienz, at the foot of the Eiger, Monch and Jungfrau mountain range.
facts.excerpt: Interlaken lies between Lakes Thun and Brienz, at the foot of the Eiger, Mönch and Jungfrau mountain range.

facts.text: The hotel is set amid the mountain scenery of the Bernese Oberland.
facts.excerpt: the Victoria-Jungfrau is a haven of tranquillity amid the glorious mountain scenery of the Bernese Oberland

facts.text: The Spa Nescens covers 5,500 square meters.
facts.excerpt: the Spa Nescens invites you to immerse yourself in 5,500 m² dedicated to holistic wellbeing

facts.text: The Spa Nescens interiors are inspired by a 1940s boudoir.
facts.excerpt: Its refined interiors, subtly inspired by a 1940s boudoir, contrast beautifully with the panoramic mountain views

facts.text: Mountain views can be seen from the spa's outdoor brine pool.
facts.excerpt: the elegant interior contrasts with the rugged mountain scenery visible from the outdoor brine pool

facts.text: Inside, the spa has a pool, steam baths, relaxation rooms, a gym and treatment rooms.
facts.excerpt: Inside, a 20-meter pool, steam baths, serene relaxation rooms, a state-of-the-art gym, and generously appointed treatment rooms

facts.text: The sauna area has a mixed Finnish sauna and steam bath, while the other facilities are separated for women and men.
facts.excerpt: The sauna area features a mixed Finnish sauna and steam bath, while the remaining facilities are thoughtfully separated for women and men.

facts.text: Spa Nescens received the Falstaff Spa Guide Award 2026 with 99 points as Best Classic Spa-Hotel in Switzerland.
facts.excerpt: Falstaff Spa Guide Award 2026 \| 99 Points Best Classic Spa-Hotel in Switzerland

facts.text: The spa offers better-aging programmes from Nescens.
facts.excerpt: Exclusive better-aging programmes from Nescens promise a holistic approach to well-being.

facts.text: Restaurants and bars include Radius by Stefan Beer, La Terrasse Brasserie, Ristorante e Pizzeria Sapori, Victoria Bar & Terrasse and the Spa Bistro.
facts.excerpt: Radius by Stefan Beer La Terrasse Brasserie Ristorante e Pizzeria Sapori Victoria Bar & Terrasse Spa Bistro

facts.text: The Victoria Bar serves drinks beneath stuccoed ceilings or out on the terrace.
facts.excerpt: Raise a glass to a perfect mountain experience beneath stuccoed ceilings or out on the terrace

facts.text: The Victoria Bar offers signature cocktails, single malts and champagnes.
facts.excerpt: Awaiting you is an exclusive selection of signature cocktails, single malts and world-class champagnes.

facts.text: Suite categories include a Yash Chopra Suite and a Tower Suite.
facts.excerpt: Superior Suite Superior Duplex Suite Deluxe Duplex Suite Premium Suite Yash Chopra Suite Tower Suite

facts.text: Junior suite categories include a Nescens Junior Suite.
facts.excerpt: Superior Junior Suite Deluxe Junior Suite Nescens Junior Suite

facts.text: Interlaken offers river rafting, bungee jumping, hiking, biking and golfing in summer, and snowboarding, snowshoeing or tobogganing in winter.
facts.excerpt: River rafting, bungee jumping, hiking, biking, and golfing in summer; snowboarding, snowshoeing, or tobogganing in winter

facts.text: Nearby excursions include the Kleine Scheidegg, the Schilthorn with its James Bond Trail, and the Brienzer Rothorn with its steam rack railroad.
facts.excerpt: Discover the Kleine Scheidegg, the Schilthorn with its James Bond Trail, or the Brienzer Rothorn and its steam rack railroad.

facts.text: Lucerne, Bern and Zermatt are a day trip away.
facts.excerpt: Lucerne, Bern, or Zermatt are only a day trip away.

facts.text: The concierge gives tips or puts together tailor-made offers.
facts.excerpt: Our concierge will give you tips or put together a tailor-made offer.

facts.text: For the Thuner Seespiele, the hotel guarantees the best tickets.
facts.excerpt: Are you planning a visit to the Thuner Seespiele? The best tickets are guaranteed!

facts.text: With the new Jungfrau Railway, the Jungfraujoch can be reached faster.
facts.excerpt: With the new Jungfrau Railway, you can reach the legendary Jungfraujoch even faster.

facts.text: The property unites two nineteenth-century hotels and offers views of the Alps.
facts.excerpt: Uniting two nineteenth-century hotels, the property also offers views of the Alps.

facts.text: The hotel is situated between two lakes and overlooks Interlaken's central green.
facts.excerpt: this magnificent hotel situated between two lakes and overlooking Interlaken

facts.text: Rooms are decorated in Belle Epoque style.
facts.excerpt: Rooms are decorated in Belle Époque style

facts.text: The hotel is named in the Conde Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards 2017 and 2025.
facts.excerpt: Readers' Choice Awards 2017, 2025

facts.text: The hotel calls itself the Grande Dame of Swiss luxury hotels.
facts.excerpt: The Grande Dame   of Swiss luxury hotels

contradictions.note: The Conde Nast Traveler review names a Sensai Select Spa, Bel Air spa suites and La Pastateca; the current official site names the Spa Nescens and Ristorante e Pizzeria Sapori and does not list those. CNT spa/dining details were not extracted as facts.
